item.title: Sec Burgum travels to Venezuela for rare earth mineral talks weeks after Maduro arrest
item.description: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum traveled to Venezuela to explore a rare earth minerals partnership as the Trump administration seeks alternatives to China.

item.title: Ivana Trump’s Manhattan townhouse sells for $14M after $12.5M price cut
item.description: Ivana Trump's opulent Manhattan townhouse sells for $14 million after a massive price cut, reflecting ongoing luxury real estate market struggles in the city.

item.title: Major tech companies back Trump pledge to pay more for data center electricity ahead of signing
item.description: Tech giants including Google, Microsoft and Meta are set to join President Donald Trump to sign a pledge ensuring AI data center costs won't burden taxpayers with higher bills.

item.title: Target bets big on upgrades, beauty push to win back shoppers: 'Not an everything store'
item.description: Target is investing billions in remodels, merchandising and same-day delivery as its new CEO works to boost traffic and restore annual sales growth.

item.title: USDA credits Trump trade deals as agricultural deficit shrinks, farm sector gains ground
item.description: The USDA reports a drop in the agricultural trade deficit from $43.7 billion to $29 billion in 2026. Officials credit President Donald Trump's trade deals for progress.

item.title: ‘He should be careful with his words’: Waltz warns Iranian envoy after UN clash
item.description: Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions reach U.N. Security Council as diplomats exchange sharp words over Middle East conflicts and decades of proxy warfare.

item.title: Starbucks to open new office in Nashville, move some jobs from Seattle
item.description: Starbucks is planning to open a new Nashville, Tennessee, corporate office later this year as part of its North American expansion strategy, creating new jobs.

item.title: Apple unveils lower cost iPhone 17e, raises prices on MacBooks
item.description: The price increases for the company's laptops come amid a global memory shortage dubbed "RAMageddon" that is being fueled by the rise in demand for artificial intelligence.

item.title: Major frozen food recall expands to 37M pounds of Trader Joe's, Kroger products over glass concerns
item.description: Trader Joe's and Kroger issued frozen food recalls. Popular chicken fried rice, dumpling and ramen products may be contaminated with pieces of glass.

item.title: Morgan Stanley cuts 2,500 jobs despite posting record revenue year across all divisions
item.description: Morgan Stanley cuts 3% of workforce, affecting roughly 2,500 employees across investment banking and wealth management divisions in latest restructuring.
